observations.behavior: Adds a new async method getInsightSummary to PostHogAPIClient that fetches insight metadata using a cache-only endpoint, returning name and description, and handling 404s.
observations.posthog_connection: Desktop agent could use this cached summary to display insight metadata without executing the insight's query, potentially reducing query load and latency for the user.
